question: ACCELERATOR_ENTERING_THE_LOOP_COSTS_MORE_THAN_RUNNING_IT measured that the FIRST two elements of a 64-wide group cost 2.2x-15x what the remaining sixty-two cost, and named exactly one candidate against itself: 'the first iteration is where each thread FIRST TOUCHES packed, scales and x, so COLD CACHE LINES are the obvious candidate -- NOT MEASURED HERE.' It also named the probe: change WHICH LINES the first iteration touches at fixed element count.
the_variable_and_it_is_exactly_one: _localN confines every address to N groups (g % N) while the loop bound, the ITERATION COUNT, the ELEMENT COUNT, the scale-load count, the reduction, the grid and the stores are ALL UNCHANGED -- asserted line by line against the base source rather than believed. At N=1 a row touches 32 bytes of packed and 64 x elements; at N=80 it touches 2560 bytes and 5120. SAME WORK, 80x THE FOOTPRINT. The index still varies with g so the body is NOT loop-invariant and cannot be hoisted whole, which would have made the arm measure hoisting instead.

P1_IS_MINE_AND_IT_IS_REFUTED.predicted: INDISTINGUISHABLE within 10%, because this program has measured the weight reads FREE by deletion, every x read FREE by deletion, and halving the x reads FREE. Falsifier: >= 1.15x.
P1_IS_MINE_AND_IT_IS_REFUTED.measured: 1.472x and 1.453x, winning 13 of 14 and 12 of 14 round-robin rounds
P1_IS_MINE_AND_IT_IS_REFUTED.verdict: REFUTED PAST MY OWN FALSIFIER, TWICE. FOOTPRINT IS THE ENTRY COST. And the stronger form: thin2_local1 measures 0.2116 and 0.2061 ms against the TRIVIAL kernel's 0.2144 and 0.1998 -- within 1.3% and 3.2%. CONFINING THE FOOTPRINT COLLAPSES THE ENTIRE LOOP-ENTRY GAP, so the gap was never the loop, the scale loads, the reduction or the elements. It was the ADDRESS SPREAD.

P2_footprint_at_FULL_element_count.predicted: INDISTINGUISHABLE; the production-shaped version of the same question, never run before
P2_footprint_at_FULL_element_count.verdict: REFUTED TOO, and this is the number that means something for a real kernel: at the full 17408x5120 element count, spreading addresses over 2560 bytes per row instead of 64 costs 8-10%. It reproduces in direction AND magnitude across two runs. THE MEMORY SYSTEM IS NOT FREE AT PRODUCTION SHAPE, which is the first time in eight blocks that anything has moved.

P3_the_entry_gap_reproduces: 0.0971 and 0.0997 ms, inside the pre-registered 0.05-0.12 band both times
HOW_THIS_RECONCILES_WITH_THE_WEIGHT_READ: ACCELERATOR_THE_FLOOR_IS_THE_ELEMENT_NOT_THE_BYTE deleted the packed reads outright and measured a TIE, and that stands. It does not conflict with this, and the reason is the axis: THAT CONTROL BARELY CHANGED THE FOOTPRINT. Deleting packed removes 2560 bytes per row while LEAVING x's 20480 bytes and the scale loads exactly where they were, so the address spread the row touches is essentially unchanged and a footprint effect could not appear. _localN confines packed AND x AND the scales TOGETHER. A CONTROL THAT DELETES ONE OF THREE OPERANDS IS NOT A FOOTPRINT EXPERIMENT, and this is the same lesson ACCELERATOR_THE_FLOOR_SPLITS_THREE_WAYS already sealed in different words: A FIXED INTERCEPT IS ONLY AS SPECIFIC AS THE AXIS THAT WAS VARIED. Neither the deletion result nor the seven dead levers are withdrawn; what changes is that an eighth axis exists and IT IS NOT DEAD.
WHAT_THIS_IS_NOT: THE CONFINED ARM IS WRONG BY CONSTRUCTION -- it multiplies by the wrong weights, reading rel_err 0.98 against the oracle, and it is NOT A CANDIDATE KERNEL. A real matvec must read all of its weights and all of x, so this does not say a faster kernel exists; it says WHAT THE COST IS MADE OF. Whether any real kernel can recover part of the 8-10% by reordering which lanes touch which lines is a SEPARATE QUESTION AND IS NOT ANSWERED HERE.
